title: Putting Green! Desert Group Getaway in Chandler
description:
Prepare to be left speechless! This beautiful 6-bedroom, 3-bathroom Oasis in Chandler, Arizona is the ideal place for you and your family to enjoy everything this young city has to offer. Beat the heat in the resort-style backyard where you can take a swim in the pool, lounge under the gazebo, or play a round of golf on the putting green. After rinsing off with the outdoor shower, head inside and continue the fun in the game room or savor a delicious meal prepared in the fully equipped kitchen.

 The space 
307781 | TPT-21506137 | Newly Remodeled | 2,487 Sq Ft | High-Speed Internet (500 Mbps)

Bedroom Suite: King Bed | Bedroom 2: Queen Bed | Bedroom 3: Full Bed, Twin Daybed | Bedroom 4: King Bed | Bedroom 5: Queen Bed | Bedroom 6: Full Bed, Twin Bunk Bed 

OUTDOOR SPACE: Private pool (not heated), furnished gazebo, fire pit w/ seating, outdoor dining area, gas grill, lounge chairs, outdoor shower
INDOOR LIVING: All new furnishings, vaulted ceilings, air hockey, Smart TV, dining table, en-suite bathrooms, ceiling fans
KITCHEN: Breakfast bar, stainless steel appliances, Keurig coffee maker, knife block, stove/oven, microwave, dishwasher, refrigerator, breakfast table
GENERAL: Washer/dryer, linens/towels, complimentary toiletries, central air conditioning/heating, hair dryers, iron/board
FAQ: Stairs required for access, 2 external security cameras (facing out), pool depth (3’-5’), no bedrooms on main floor (upstairs or downstairs only), pool service
PARKING: Driveway (3 vehicles), RV/trailer parking allowed on site

 Guest access 
Guests will have access to the entire property via keyless entry

 Other things to note 
- No smoking
- No pets allowed
- No events, parties, or large gatherings
- Additional fees and taxes may apply
- Photo ID may be required upon check-in
- NOTE: While the home provides step-free entry, internal stairs are required to access all living areas and bedrooms
- NOTE: The property is a split-level house with 3 bedrooms upstairs, 3 bedrooms downstairs, and no bedrooms on the main floor
- NOTE: Your safety matters. This property features a Ring Doorbell device with an exterior security camera facing the front outdoor entry, and 1 external camera is located by the side gate entrance facing the driveway. The cameras are outward facing and do not look into interior spaces. The cameras record video and sound when activated by motion
- NOTE: Pool service will be at the property from Wednesday to Thursday mornings
- NOTE: The pool is not heated and the water may be chilly in the winter months
